extracted text: The paper discusses a heat treatment process for Al-Mg-Si-Cu alloy 6061. The conventional T6 heat treatment (solution heat treatment at 560°C for 2h, followed by cold water quenching and then artificial aging at 177°C) is compared with a new T6I6 heat treatment, where the T6 treatment is interrupted after 20 min at 177°C by inserting a dwell period at 65°C for 2 weeks, before resuming aging at 177°C. This interrupted aging promotes secondary precipitation of Guinier-Preston (GP) zones, leading to a finer and denser dispersion of β″ precipitates when aging is resumed.

abbreviations:
T6: Solution heat treatment and artificial aging at 177°C
T6I6: T6 interrupted by aging at lower temperature (65°C)
UA: Underaged at 177°C for 20 min
T6I4: UA followed by aging at 65°C for 2 weeks
